brand.name: Elite Eye
brand.tagline: Where designer meets sentiment and good taste
brand.description: Private gift consulting for Dallas' most discerning households. Luxury gifting, sourced and styled by a single trusted eye.

hero.headline: Where designer meets sentiment and good taste
hero.subhead: You know the gift should be extraordinary. You do not have forty hours to find it. I do that part — quietly, personally, and with an eye trained on the details most people miss.
hero.imageAlt: Iridescent Gucci boxes and gift bag from an Elite Eye presentation

proof.line: Chanel · Dior · Yves Saint Laurent · Gucci · Louis Vuitton · Louboutin — and the small houses you have not heard of yet.

problem.heading: The gift is never really about the gift
body: It is about being seen. A gift that lands says I paid attention. A gift that misses says the opposite, loudly, and it is remembered.

I know how frustrating it is to tell someone exactly what you want and watch them miss the mark. And for the rest of us — we genuinely want to give something beautiful, but it is time-consuming, and the good things are never on the first page of results.
Elite Eye takes the searching off your plate. I find the pieces you would not otherwise find, and I present them so the moment of opening is as considered as the object itself.

services.title: Private Gift Consulting
services.summary: One conversation about the person, the occasion, and the relationship — then a curated proposal of pieces, sourced and presented for you.
detail: We start with a call. Not about products — about the person receiving the gift. What they already own, what they would never buy for themselves, what they have quietly mentioned twice.

From there I source. I search well past the obvious retailers: limited editions, exclusive releases, small houses, and the occasional piece that takes a phone call to a person rather than a click on a site.
You receive a curated proposal with options at a defined budget. You choose. I handle acquisition, authentication, presentation, and discreet delivery.
includes: Discovery call about the recipient and the occasion
Curated proposal, sourced to your budget
Authentication on every designer piece
Presentation and packaging designed to be opened, not unwrapped
Discreet delivery or hand-off coordination

services.title: Corporate & Executive Gifting
services.summary: A gifting program for the clients and partners you cannot afford to send a branded tumbler.
detail: At a certain level, a corporate gift is a positioning statement. It tells your best client what tier of relationship they are in — and a generic one tells them something you did not intend.

I build gifting programs for firms, family offices, and private practices: a defined tier structure, a sourcing calendar ahead of the holiday crush, and a record of who received what, so no one is sent the same thing twice.
Nothing is logo-stamped unless you ask. The point is that it does not look like it came from a catalog.
includes: Tiered gift structure mapped to your relationship levels
Recipient intelligence, so the gift fits the person and not just the tier
Sourcing calendar set ahead of Q4 scarcity
Recipient log to prevent repeats year over year
Coordinated shipping and arrival timing

services.title: Weddings & Milestones
services.summary: Bridal party gifts, anniversary pieces, and milestone gifting handled as one cohesive collection rather than nine separate errands.
detail: A wedding produces a dozen gifting decisions at exactly the moment you have the least attention to spend on them: the bridal party, the parents, the host, the planner, the couple themselves.
I treat them as one collection. Consistent in taste, individual to each person, and delivered on a schedule that does not depend on you remembering it.
The same applies to the milestones that follow — anniversaries, births, the birthdays that carry weight.
includes: A single cohesive collection across every recipient
Individual personalization within a consistent aesthetic
Timeline managed to the event date
Presentation suitable for a room full of photographs
Coordination with your planner where one exists

services.title: The Elite Custom
services.summary: A fully bespoke presentation built around one person. Designer pieces, assembled and styled, with at least one limited edition or exclusive item in every box.
detail: The original Elite Eye service, and still the one people ask for by name.

Every box is built for a specific person rather than assembled from a standing inventory. Every designer item is authenticated or goes through an authentication process. Shipping packaging is deliberately discreet.
At least one limited edition or exclusive piece is guaranteed in every box — something the recipient could not have simply ordered themselves.
includes: Fully bespoke to one recipient
Guaranteed limited edition or exclusive piece
All designer items authenticated
Styled presentation, photographed before it ships
Discreet outer packaging

process.title: The call
process.body: Twenty minutes, complimentary. We talk about the recipient, the occasion, the relationship, and the budget you are working within.

process.title: The search
process.body: I source privately — limited editions, exclusive releases, and pieces that are not sitting in a search result. This is the part that would have cost you your weekend.

process.title: The proposal
process.body: A curated set of options within your budget, with the reasoning behind each. You choose. Nothing is purchased until you do.

process.title: The presentation
process.body: Acquisition, authentication, styling, and packaging. Delivered discreetly, or handed to you ready to give.

about.heading: The eye behind it
body: This service is designed to make it easier to gift tasteful and beautiful items. Hand-picked by me, these are pieces I search the ends of the internet for — and would readily give to myself or to my own family.
[BIO PLACEHOLDER — two or three sentences from Rachel: background, how the eye was trained, why Dallas. Until this is written the paragraph is omitted from the site.]
Elite Eye is deliberately small. I take a limited number of engagements so that every one of them gets an actual eye on it — mine.

faq.a: The introductory call is complimentary. If we move forward, engagements are quoted based on scope; bespoke work generally begins at $800 plus the cost of the pieces themselves.
Yes. Most clients are in Highland Park, University Park, Preston Hollow, and the surrounding area, but sourcing and delivery are not geographically limited.
Every designer item is either sourced through an authorized channel or put through an authentication process before it reaches you. This is non-negotiable.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: For the holidays, by early autumn — the best pieces are limited and they go. For an individual occasion, two to three weeks is comfortable. Shorter timelines are sometimes possible; ask.

faq.q: Can you work within a set budget?
faq.a: Yes, and I prefer to. Tell me the number on the first call and every option you see will respect it.
Yes. The presentation inside is styled to be photographed; the shipping packaging outside gives nothing away.

cta.heading: Give something they could not have found themselves
cta.body: A short call is the whole commitment. Tell me who it is for and I will tell you what is possible.
